summary: Frontend regression test of refactored PostCard, Gallery, and AdminDashboard. All extracted child components (PostMedia, PostActions, PostMenu, GalleryGrid, GalleryItemModal, UploadModal, StatsBar, AnnouncementsSection, AnnouncementModal, UsersPanel/QuickUserRow, PostsPanel, CommunityPanel/CommunityPostRow, ActivityLogPanel, ConfirmDialog) render and integrate correctly. No regressions, no JS errors, no broken imports detected.

frontend: Login (admin@homesteadhub.com/admin123) -> dashboard loads with all sidebar nav-* testids
PostCard: post-<id>, post-avatar, post-username, post-description render
PostCard PostActions child: like-post-<id> click toggles like; toggle-comments-<id> opens comments-section-<id> and lazily loads comments
PostCard PostMenu child: post-menu-btn opens post-menu-dropdown with correct owner-based items (View Profile / Edit Post / Delete Post for own post)
PostCard PostMedia child: images grid does not crash when post has no images (returns null)
Admin nav: nav-admin (desktop visible variant) -> admin-dashboard renders
StatsBar: exactly 6 StatCards present with testids stat-users, stat-verified, stat-posts, stat-messages, stat-connections, stat-invites
AnnouncementsSection lists 4 announcements; 'New' opens AnnouncementModal with heading 'New Announcement'
Editing existing announcement opens AnnouncementModal with heading 'Edit Announcement' and textarea pre-populated with stored message
PostsPanel delete trigger -> ConfirmDialog opens with 'Confirm Action' heading; Cancel dismisses
UsersPanel: QuickUserRow caret dropdown shows View Profile / Verify / Promote / Delete actions
CommunityPanel and ActivityLogPanel render section headers correctly
Profile -> 'View My Gallery' opens Gallery panel (gallery-panel testid)
Gallery UploadModal opens via gallery-upload-btn; gallery-upload-modal, gallery-file-input, gallery-caption-input, gallery-upload-submit all present
No console errors and no pageerror events during all flows

not_tested: GalleryItemModal open/like/comment - admin gallery was empty, no items to click. Component file is structurally correct (data-testid='gallery-item-modal', gallery-modal-like wired, ThreadedComments integrated) but live interaction not exercised. Recommend seeding a gallery item or testing as demo user with content if higher confidence needed.
Actual file upload submission to /api/gallery/upload (only modal open + form fields verified)
'Report Post' menu item end-to-end - in PostMenu.js it currently only calls setOpen(false) with no report-flow handler. Pre-existing behavior, not a refactor regression.
critical_code_review_comments: PostMenu.js: 'Report Post' button (post-menu-report-<id>) only closes the menu - no onReport prop or API call. Pre-existing limitation, but worth wiring up.

AdminDashboard.js: handleVerify/handleChangeRole/handleSaveAnnouncement/handleDeleteAnnouncement don't surface errors to the user (only console.error). Consider toast on failure for parity with rest of app.
GalleryGrid.js destructures `currentUserId` is passed from Gallery.js but not used inside GalleryGrid - dead prop, can be removed.
PostActions.js: `postId` prop is only used for data-testid - fine, but consider memoizing PostActions/PostMedia/PostMenu (React.memo) since PostCard re-renders on every like state change.
Gallery.js handleItemClick falls back to local `item` on API error which lacks comments/full metadata - acceptable degraded path.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing posts/users/announcements. No mutations committed (Edit Announcement was cancelled, PostsPanel delete was cancelled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactoring of PostCard, Gallery, AdminDashboard into sub-components verified clean. nav-admin and nav-profile appear duplicated in DOM (desktop sidebar + mobile sidebar both present) - when scripting, iterate query_selector_all and click the visible one. GalleryItemModal live interaction wasn't exercised because admin gallery is empty.
